_about: Public-domain John Berridge (1716-1793, evangelical vicar of Everton) for the Word Hoard: his Works with Richard Whittingham's memoir (1838, containing The Christian World Unmasked and Sion's Songs), A Fragment of the True Religion (1760) and Cheerful Piety, select letters (Brooklyn, catalogued 1812), raw Internet Archive OCR. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 17 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

berridge-works-1838: The Works of the Rev. John Berridge, with an enlarged memoir, ed. Richard Whittingham (London: Simpkin, Marshall; Potton: Frazer, 1838)
berridge-fragment-1760: A Fragment of the True Religion, being the substance of two letters (London: J. Williams, MDCCLX)
berridge-cheerful-piety: Cheerful Piety, or Religion without Gloom: select letters (Brooklyn: Thomas Kirk; catalogued 1812)

_alternates.berridge-first-editions: The Christian World Unmasked (London, 1773; IA bim_eighteenth-century_the-christian-world-unma_berridge-john_1773) and Sion's Songs (1785; IA bim_eighteenth-century_sions-songs-or-hymns-_berridge-john_1785): first editions, long-s OCR; their text is in the 1838 Works
_alternates.berridge-works-1864: The Whole Works, 2nd ed. (London: Palmer, 1864; IA wholeworksofrevj00berruoft)

berridge-fragment-1760.author: Published anonymously ("a Methodist-Preacher in Cambridgeshire", London: J. Williams, 1760); attributed to Berridge by the IA catalogue, and the text names Everton, his parish. Attribution is catalogue-based, not title-page.
